description: Main shared-backbone + per-version LoRA run (v3): restart dataset collection for 150k backbone files over Python 3.6-3.15 and 150k training files per adapter. Reuse the frozen v1 tokenizer; every other setting and the v1/v2 evaluation protocol are unchanged from v2. Do not resume v2 weights.
approval: User approved on 2026-11-02: abort the 100k run, restart from dataset collection with 150k files, then rerun training. All other settings unchanged; do not retrain the tokenizer. This means 150k backbone files and 150k training files per LoRA version; retain 1k validation files per version.

backbone.rule: run_local_tokenizer_preparation --versions 3.6..3.15: seeded NAS sampling, canonical-hash training bucket only, every eval v1/v2 source excluded by NAS identity, raw SHA-512 and canonical hash

adapter.rule: build_adapter_pools: 90/10 PyPI/CSN, validation = canonical-hash reserved bucket, disjoint from the backbone corpus, eval sources and each other

notes.supersedes: shared-v2-main-2026-11-01.json; the 100k run was stopped by user request. Fresh roots and v3 Hub repos isolate all v2 checkpoints. Pending input revisions must be pinned before any lane starts.
notes.same_as_v2: Only backbone and adapter training file budgets change from 100k to 150k. Validation size, 90/10 mix, version allocation, seeds, epochs, optimizer settings, batches, precision, rank, checkpoint schedule, initialization, host layout, exclusion protocol, and v1/v2 benchmark remain unchanged.
notes.tokenizer: Reuse the exact v1 statement and segmentation tokenizers and their registries. No tokenizer fitting, vocabulary changes, or opcode-slot changes.
notes.encoding_hosts: triplesec1 encodes universal/statement and adapter/3.14; triplesec2 encodes universal/segmentation and adapter/3.15. Each publishes its paths before training consumes them.

results.verification: All five public final revisions and final-step resumable checkpoints independently verified against the hosts; both adapters have the same frozen backbone, tokenizer and opcode registry. No data or training settings changed.

benchmark.approved: Same official v1/v2 3.14/3.15 benchmark as the approved v2 plan; user explicitly requested it for v3.
benchmark.code: benchmark_shared_v1.py, unchanged scoring and paired no_adapter/statement_adapter arms
benchmark.protocol: strict full-file bytecode equivalence, FP32, 300 s per file, every listed file; compilers 3.14.6 / 3.15.0b2; TORCH_DISABLE_NATIVE_JIT=1
